audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal timing on Surround Sound (W) and the Stage Presence (P) auto-reset tell were both listed in missingInteractions but not stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: W only heals once it's already shielding (double-cast off P triggers), so anti-heal matters on extended trades; P's every-third-cast auto-reset is the wind-up tell before her all-in.
audit.corrected: Named Surround Sound (W) in the itemization anti-heal line; auto-reset tell left for a future pass (see notes) due to length-band constraints on the fields that could hold it.
